mappings.note: Both contain the superscription 'To the choir director. With stringed instruments. Of David.' (Hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ... vs Norwegian: Til korlederen...)
Both contain 'Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer!' (Hebrew: שִׁמְעָה אֱלֹהִים... vs Norwegian: Hør mitt rop...)
Both contain the plea from 'the end of the earth' and being led to a rock higher than oneself.
Both describe God as a refuge and strong tower against enemies.
Both contain dwelling in the tent forever and shelter under wings. Includes 'Selah' (Sela).
Both mention God hearing vows and giving the inheritance to those who fear His name.

Translation verse 7 contains only the first half of OSMAIN v7 ('Add days to the king's years...'). The second part of OSMAIN v7 ('May he sit forever before God; let lovingkindness and faithfulness preserve him') is found in Translation verse 8.
Translation verse 8 contains the second half of OSMAIN v7 ('May he sit forever before God...'). It does not contain the final sentence found in Translation verse 9.
Both contain 'Then I will praise your name forever and fulfill my vows day by day.' (Hebrew: כֵּן אֲזַמְרָה... vs Norwegian: Da vil jeg lovsynge...)
